messages.subject: Melting and subsetting data for shiny app
parts:
Hi
My dataset has the following columns:

name   year sex  n prop  city1 city 2 city 3 .....

A          2010                   30     40     30
B          2011                   20      30    20
C          2012                   15       20    15

I need to filter this data by entering a name for example A (in Shiny app)

so for this name I get dataset:

year city density

where density is collected from corresponding numbers under city1 city 2 etc

Please help

messages.author: e84fc3fecc615fb7
messages.subject: Re: Melting and subsetting data for shiny app
parts:
Here a solution using data.table package

library(data.table)
data=data.table(name=c('a','b','c'), year=c('2010','2011','2012'),city1=c(30,20,15),city2=c(40,30,20),city3=c(30,20,15))
sel.name='a'
selcols=grep('city',names(data))
tot.city=data[name==sel.name,sum(.SD),.SDcols=selcols]

3:    a 2010    city3    30
